indexOptionDemoGuide:
The demo creates a fake wallet on devnet and walks you through the sections: portfolio, FiMs, community, tontine, votes, explorer…

No real funds, everything is cleaned up on exit. Replayable anytime from Settings → Guided tour.
indexOptionExternalGuide:
Your keys stay in the wallet extension — every transaction is signed there, FiMs never sees your keys.

The safest choice if you already use a Solana wallet.
indexOptionImportGuide:
Your keys are stored encrypted locally in this browser — FiMs then signs your transactions directly after your password.

Only import on a trusted device: the words you enter never leave this device.
indexOptionNewGuide:
FiMs will generate a 12-word recovery phrase — the MASTER key to your wallet.

• Write it down on PAPER, stored somewhere safe — never on a cloud, a phone note or a screenshot.
• Never share it: anyone who knows it owns your funds.
• The FiMs team will NEVER ask for it.
• Lost phrase = lost funds. Stolen phrase = stolen funds.
indexPageDescription: We hope you enjoy your stay!
onboardingPageDescription: You can now start using FiMs Wallet!
walletProtectionPinWarning: A PIN only stops casual access — anyone who reads this device's storage can brute-force it offline, and a 4-digit PIN falls in seconds. Use 8+ digits, or prefer a full password for funded wallets.
walletProtectionUnsecuredConfirm: Type {{phrase}} to confirm this wallet will not be protected by a password or PIN.
walletProtectionUnsecuredWarning: Anyone with access to this browser profile may be able to use this wallet.
